news.title:
Goldman Sachs downgrades Infosys, TCS, and Tech Mahindra citing high valuations, slowing growth, and an IT sector downcycle.
Wipro upgraded due to attractive valuations and growth potential; broader IT sector faces headwinds, especially in Europe and discretionary spending.

Tech Mahindra's subsidiary acquired 85% stake in Alluri Technologies.
The move targets BFSI vertical, boosting payment modernization and wealth management.

news.title:

Avant specializes in payments modernization, wealth platforms, and AI-driven solutions, strengthening Tech Mahindra's offerings.

news.title:
Tech Mahindra's FY26 revenue rose 1.9% YoY to $6.385B, with Q4 up 4.9% YoY.
FY26 deal wins totaled $3.79B, a 42% YoY rise, driven by AI and digital strategies.

Infosys, HCLTech, and Tech Mahindra focus on profitability, avoiding low-margin deals as AI impacts traditional outsourcing models.
HCLTech and Infosys reported slower growth as they prioritized margins, with AI-led automation compressing deal values.
